description: This file defines middleware for handling errors in an ASP.NET Core web application. It intercepts exceptions during request processing and serializes error responses based on exception type.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling exceptions and returning JSON error responses in an ASP.NET Core app.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method to process the HTTP context, catches exceptions and delegates to handler.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions, sets appropriate status codes, and serializes error information into the response.
